Source-qualified whole-action addition: section259 prohibits Act-funded ANY SERVICES to an individual who is BOTH unlawfully present in the United States AND not eligible for healthcare under laws administered by the VASecretary. The eligibility predicate is retained; this is not a blanket prohibition on all noncitizens,all unlawfully present persons or all government services. The funding scope is this Act,not all federal funds. No individual presence or VA-eligibility finding is made. The existing clinical and other benefit conditions remain; this rider does not establish a new personal admission/removal rule or revoke all veteran healthcare rights.

Section410 bars using funds made available by THIS ACT to execute a contract for goods or services, including construction, where the contractor has not complied with ExecutiveOrder12989. This is a source-traced employment/immigration verification funding condition, not an inference from military or VA agency names. The dated2024consolidated order's section1 refers to INA274A(a)(1)(A)/(a)(2)'s knowing unauthorized-alien hiring/continued-employment rules; section5 requires agreement to use the DHS-designated electronic employment-eligibility system for specified US hires and assigned workers. Unauthorized employment at a particular time is distinct from immigration presence, nationality or lawful permanent residence alone:1324a(h)(3) retains permanent residence OR authorization to be so employed. Antidiscrimination obligations remain. Contractor underFAR9.403 includes an individual or legal entity, affiliates and the specified bidding/contract/subcontract/agency relationships, not a citizen-only ownership class.

The dated2024FAR implementation is bounded.22.1803 prescribes52.222-54 for contracts exceeding$150,000, with outside-US-only work,less-than120day and specifiedCOTS/bulk-cargo/associated-service exceptions.22.1802 allows exceptional nondelegable contracting-head waivers.52.222-54 defines assigned workers by direct US contract work and post-November6,1986 hire (post-November27,2009 inCNMI); indirect/overhead work without substantial contract duties is excluded. It distinguishes general new US hires from optional assigned-worker-only verification for higher-education,State/local/recognized-Tribal government or takeover-surety contractors. Electing verification of other existing employees is optional and has its own180day timing. Enrollment/verification periods and prior-verification,active-clearance/HSPD12 exemptions remain; qualifying services/construction subcontracts must exceed$3,500 and involve US work. MOU termination produces referral and interim excusal pending a suspension/debarment decision, not automatic guilt or exclusion. The order's investigation/hearing/agency determination and generally offending-unit debarment scope,one-year/continued-violation extensions remain. No individual employment authorization,current contract/MOU/waiver,all-workforce mandate,actual debarment or workforce-performance claim is certified. The bill does not first create or rewrite these underlying programmes; the2024sources are a dated qualified baseline,not a certificate of current implementation.
